comparison: exact signed integer PCM and explicit named state words; no gain, shift or tolerance
cold_start: export begins at the final upstream powerCycle after factory SRAM setup; RESET clears XP and LSP, mappings survive; no H8 state snapshot is imported
record_layout: little-endian <QI BBHII: frame:uint64, sequence:uint32, kind:uint8, chip:uint8, address:uint16, value:uint32, crc32:uint32
crc: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over the first 20 record bytes and any checkpoint payload; required Trace format check field, not an artifact digest
header: 80 bytes: SC88TRC1[8], version:u32, sample_rate:u32, boot_frames:u64, case_frames:u64, upstream_commit ASCII[40], checkpoint_interval:u32, header_crc32:u32
checkpoint: value is payload byte count; payload is little-endian uint64 named field sequence. Observational assertions only, never injected into replay state. Initial, every 32768 completed frames, and END. Voice, XP control/PRAM/CRAM/IRAM/ERAM/datapath/serial, LSP program/IRAM/ERAM/datapath/config and return gate.
schedule: frame zero is first post-constructor renderSample. Reads/writes/return gate/IRQ observations precede FRAME in exact recorded order. FRAME runs XP, observes SDOC and SDOB, processes LSP, then stages SDIA return shifted right 8 for the next frame. END follows precisely boot_frames+case_frames FRAME records.
coverage_limit: CPU decoupling of recorded fixed-reference executions only; not a native MIDI parameter generator, cycle-accurate Roland bus, silicon equivalence, HLS or board validation
